desc: Savage's 110 Haymaker model offers precision and power for the deer, bear, and hog hunter. It features Savage's AccuFit synthetic stock with five comb riser sizes for the perfect cheek-to-stock weld, four composite inserts to establish your unique length-of-pull, and AccuStock. The AccuStock consists of a rigid rail system firmly embedded in the stock throughout the foreend of the rifle. It also engages the action three dimensionally along its entire length. The 110 Wolverine also features AccuTrigger for flexibility, a button-rifled carbon steel barrel with a ported muzzle break, 20 MOA mounted rail, soft grip fore-end and pistol grip, and a Magpul AICS-style detachable box magazine.
